row.body: PR 1188 (YEAR-SIM-1) owns foundation/yearsim.py, doctrine/yearsim.json, ops/yearsim.json and /year: a Monte Carlo of recovery code. The monthly failure-injection test is foundation/yearfail.py, doctrine/yearfail.json, ops/yearfail.json and /year/failures. The tenant's ops/yearsim.json is unchanged.
